items.title: Lucky Lilac's first
items.text: Lucky Lilac, third favourite, won in 2:14.1. Crocosmia was second for the third year running (2017, 2018, 2019).

items.title: Lucky Lilac again
items.text: Run at Hanshin while Kyoto was rebuilt. Lucky Lilac won it a second year in a row, as favourite, in 2:10.3.

items.title: Akai Ito at 10th favourite
items.text: At Hanshin again. Akai Ito won at 10th favourite, two lengths clear of Stellaria.

items.title: A dead heat for second
items.text: Geraldina won at Hanshin; Win Marilyn and Lilac could not be split and shared second place.

items.title: Back at Kyoto
items.text: The race returned to the rebuilt Kyoto. Brede Weg won as favourite in 2:12.6.

items.title: Regaleira's race record
items.text: Regaleira won as favourite in 2:11.0, the race record, 1¾ lengths ahead of Paradis Reine.
